_desc: /resume page — H1 + subtitle + embedded PDF (70vh iframe, rounded border).
_sources: Self-hosted PDF provided by Mit (2026-07-25), replacing the earlier Google Drive link. The PDF lives at content/files/ and is synced to public/files/ by scripts/sync-images.mjs; 'file' is its public URL path.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle (reference UI copy).
_fields.driveUrl: Google Drive share URL (used only when source = 'drive').
_fields.file: Public URL path to a self-hosted PDF. Put the file in content/files/ (synced to public/files/) and reference it as '/files/<name>.pdf'.

subtitle: View and download my professional resume.
